name: LaserFlow-TS-TW
title: Laser Flow
description: One thin shaft of pink light climbs from a soft horizontal pool at the bottom of a black stage, with faint streaks drifting along it. The beam leans a little as the pointer moves.
use: A dark hero, event page or album cover needs one dramatic shaft of light.
avoid: Light themes or busy layouts: it needs black space to read and carries no content.
a11y: Decorative canvas with no role or label; the motion never stops and ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage holds a single slender vertical shaft of hot pink light rising from a wide, soft elliptical pool near the bottom. The pool fades outward into darkness, with a faint haze around the base.
behaves: The shaft fades in on load and keeps a slow flicker while fine streaks drift down its length. Moving the pointer tilts the beam and haze slightly, then it eases back.
customise: Beam colour, flow speed, wisp density, fog intensity, offsets and sizing are props. The shader body and its named constants need a source edit.
weight: heavy: A WebGL fragment shader renders every frame with layered noise and fog.
